messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High-severity: Metering pipeline delay detected in eu-west-1. Token aggregation lag >10m; provisional overage flags created for a subset of customers.

sara_ops: got it, i'm on it — checking consumer lags and emitter heartbeats :mag:

mike_oncall: running quick offsets check: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-eu --bootstrap-server pk:9092` — seeing partition 3 lag 1.2M msgs

jamal_eng: FYI deployed a quantization rollout at 03:45 UTC that touched metering writer; could be I/O pressure. No errors in pods though.

sara_ops: requeued consumer for partition 3 and increased parallelism to 6. watching lag metric (metering.consumer.lag.partition3)

billing-bot: NOTICE: provisional overage flags set for sample customers: cust-ACME, cust-NOVA, cust-ORION — flags are provisional and marked for reconciliation

laura_cs: @sara_ops can we suppress customer-facing overage emails until we reconcile? customers already pinging support.

sara_ops: yes — plan: 1) pause overage alerting for eu region, 2) resume full consumption + run backfill on last 30m, 3) reconcile flags and clear provisional ones. executing step 1 now.

mike_oncall: launching backfill: `./scripts/recompute_counts --start 2026-03-17T03:30Z --end 2026-03-17T04:00Z --region eu-west-1` — ETA ~8m

jamal_eng: applying temporary config: `billing.alerts.overage.enabled=false` for eu-west-1 in staging then prod. will revert after reconciliation.

sara_ops: consumer lag trending down after parallelism bump. backfill started, monitoring token deltas.

laura_cs: I'll post a support note: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting in EU. You may see temporary overage flags; no final billing changes will be applied until reconciliation completes." sending to triage channel.

mike_oncall: backfill finished — recomputed counts align with expected baselines, provisional flags cleared.

billing-bot: RESOLVED: Metering delay resolved for eu-west-1. Root cause: consumer parallelism dropped after rollout causing backlog. Mitigation: increased parallelism, backfilled counts, temporarily suppressed alerts. Follow-up: add alert on consumer lag >5m and rollback change in deploy.

sara_ops: filing postmortem stub with timeline and action items. owners: jamal_eng for deploy rollback checklist, mike_oncall for alerting rule, laura_cs for customer comms :spiral_calendar:
